headline: Two teams surge into ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: AquaUrsa Research jumped from 467th to 14th, gaining 8.76 points to reach 38.97 and move into the 18 gold places.
speed, my mom is kinda homless also entered gold, climbing from 435th to 16th after a 7.96-point gain to 38.22. The team now sits two places behind AquaUrsa Research.
